'''Margaret Denise Quigley''' (born May 22, 1979), known professionally as '''Maggie Q''', is an American actress. She began her professional career [[Cinema of Hong Kong|in Hong Kong]], with starring roles in the action films ''[[Gen-Y Cops]]'' (2000) and ''[[Naked Weapon]]'' (2002), before appearing in the American productions ''[[Mission: Impossible III]]'' (2006), ''[[Live Free or Die Hard]]'' (2007), ''[[Priest (2011 film)|Priest]]'' (2011) and ''[[The Protégé]]'' (2021). She portrayed [[List of Divergent characters#Tori Wu|Tori Wu]] in the dystopian science-fiction action film ''[[Divergent (film)|Divergent]]'' (2014), and reprised her role in the sequels, ''[[The Divergent Series: Insurgent|Insurgent]]'' (2015) and ''[[The Divergent Series: Allegiant|Allegiant]]'' (2016). Q starred in [[Nikita Mears|the title role]] on [[the CW]] action-thriller series ''[[Nikita (TV series)|Nikita]]'' (2010–2013), and also had a main role as FBI special agent Hannah Wells in the [[American Broadcasting Company|ABC]]/[[Netflix]] [[political thriller]] series ''[[Designated Survivor (TV series)|Designated Survivor]]'' (2016–2019). She provided the voice of [[Wonder Woman]] on the animated series ''[[Young Justice (TV series)|Young Justice]]'' (2012–2019). In 2025, Q began starring in the lead role of Detective Renée Ballard on the [[Prime Video]] series ''[[Ballard (TV series)|Ballard]]'', a spinoff of the television series ''[[Bosch: Legacy]]''.

==Career==
[[File:Flickr - Sasoriza - Maggie Q.jpg|thumb|Q at the world premiere of ''[[The Warrior and the Wolf]]'' in 2009]]

=== 1996–2005: Modeling and Hong Kong films ===
At a friend's suggestion, Q began modeling in [[Tokyo]], Japan at the age of 17, before making an unsuccessful move to [[Taipei]], Taiwan. She tried again in [[Hong Kong]], where she began using the [[stage name]] Maggie Q because the locals could not pronounce Quigley properly.<ref name=MililaniMidweek/><ref name=NYMag/><ref name=GoingtoAsiaNYT>{{cite news|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2007/02/08/arts/08iht-maggie.html?pagewanted=2&sq=Maggie%20Q&st=cse&scp=3|title=The Maggie Q story: Gone to Asia with an eye toward Hollywood|work=The New York Times|access-date=October 24, 2010|first=Robert|last=Ito|date=February 8, 2007}}</ref> She has said it was not easy for her: "I had twenty bucks in my pocket. I mean, I literally did the same thing that my mother did when she left Vietnam... didn't speak the language... had no money."<ref name=VietnameseImmigrantMomGLTonight/> But in Hong Kong, she became a protégé of [[Jackie Chan]], who saw in her a potential action star. His intensive training taught her the importance of professionalism and always doing her own [[stunt]]s. She later said: "I had never done a day of [[martial arts]] in my life when I started in the business. I couldn't even touch my toes."<ref name=NYMag/> Over the course of her career, Q trained in multiple martial arts disciplines, including [[Wushu (sport)|Chinese Wushu]], [[Qigong]], and [[Wing Chun]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zarza |first=Emily |date=2014-03-31 |title=Profile of Maggie Q |url=http://kungfukingdom.com/profile-of-maggie-q/ |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=Kung-fu Kingdom |language=en-GB}}</ref>

In 1998,<ref name=DeceptionLATimes>{{cite news|url=https://www.latimes.com/entertainment/la-et-performance24apr24,0,5726076.story|title=Maggie Q in 'Deception'|work=Los Angeles Times|access-date=October 24, 2010|first=Jodie|last=Burke|date=April 24, 2008}}</ref> she started her acting career in the TV drama ''House of the Dragon'', which was a huge hit in Asia. In 2000, she made her film debut as Anna in the horror film ''Model from Hell'', and went on to star as FBI agent Jane Quigley in the action thriller ''[[Gen-Y Cops]]'' that year. Her appearance in ''Gen-Y Cops'' impressed Chan so much that he cast her in his films ''Manhattan Midnight'' and ''[[Rush Hour 2]]''.<ref name=MililaniMidweek/>

In 2002, she starred as martial artist assassin Charlene Ching in the action film ''[[Naked Weapon]]''. In 2004, she co-starred with [[Kelly Hu]], [[Russell Wong]] and other Asian-American actors in a 30-second PSA produced by Mark Allen for CAUSE USA (Center for Asian Americans United for Self Empowerment), ''The Least Likely'', encouraging Asian and Pacific Islander Americans to register and vote.<ref>[http://www.committee100.org/media/media_eng/cause-launches-public-srvc-announcement.html CAUSE Launches New Public Service Announcement Urging Young Asian Americas To Vote].</ref><ref>[https://library.creativecow.net/article.php?author_folder=wilson_tim&article_folder=cin_comp&page=1 Building Cinematic Composites: A Creative COW Magazine Extra], interview with Mark Allen.</ref><ref>''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_y-501er5x8 The Least Likely]'' on Allen's YouTube channel.</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.causeusa.org/|title=CAUSE|website=CAUSE}}</ref> In 2005, she played Harmony in the German-Singaporean TV mini-series ''[[House of Harmony]]'', opposite [[Fann Wong]], and co-produced the animal treatment documentary ''[[Earthlings (film)|Earthlings]]'' narrated by [[Joaquin Phoenix]].<ref name=EarthlingsCastCrew>{{cite web|url=http://www.earthlings.com/earthlings/cast-crew.php |title=Single Most Powerful Information With Professional Cast and Crew in EARTHLINGS |publisher=Nation Earth |access-date=October 23, 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100818215336/http://www.earthlings.com/earthlings/cast-crew.php |archive-date=August 18, 2010 }}</ref>

===2006–2013: Hollywood career and ''Nikita''===
[[File:LyndsyFonescaMaggieQSDCCJuly10.jpg|thumb|[[Lyndsy Fonseca]] and Q at a panel for the television series ''[[Nikita (TV series)|Nikita]]'' at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2010.]]
In 2006, Q made her Hollywood breakthrough as co-star in ''[[Mission: Impossible III]]'' alongside [[Tom Cruise]]. She played Zhen, the only female member of the [[Impossible Missions Force|IMF]] team. In 2007, she appeared as Mai Linh in the [[Bruce Willis]] movie ''[[Live Free or Die Hard]]'',<ref name="MililaniMidweek" /> the fourth film in the [[Die Hard (film series)|''Die Hard'' series]], and as Maggie in ''[[Balls of Fury]]''. In 2008, she played fictional Cao Ying, a granddaughter of the warlord [[Cao Cao]] in ''[[Three Kingdoms: Resurrection of the Dragon]]'', her first ancient Chinese costume performance. That year, she also appeared in the drama/thriller movie ''[[Deception (2008 film)|Deception]]'' starring [[Ewan McGregor]] and [[Hugh Jackman]], as Tina, an investment banker<ref name="DeceptionLATimes" /> who introduces Jackman's character to an exclusive anonymous sex club list. She also stars in the video game ''[[Need for Speed: Undercover]]'' as the seductive lead character, federal agent Chase Linh, the player's only contact to the Tri-City Police.<ref name="NeedfSpeedTxb">{{cite web|url=http://news.teamxbox.com/xbox/17328/Maggie-Q-to-Star-in-Need-for-Speed-Undercover|title=International Box Office Sensation Maggie Q to Star in Need for Speed Undercover|publisher=teamxbox|access-date=October 23, 2010|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110505090948/http://news.teamxbox.com/xbox/17328/Maggie-Q-to-Star-in-Need-for-Speed-Undercover|archive-date=May 5, 2011}}</ref>

==Personal life==
After meeting her ''Stalker'' co-star [[Dylan McDermott]] on-set in early 2014, their engagement was announced on January 14, 2015.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.upi.com/Entertainment_News/TV/2015/01/18/Dylan-McDermott-and-Maggie-Q-get-engaged/6661421593073/ |title=Dylan McDermott and Maggie Q get engaged |first=Karen |last=Butler |work=[[United Press International]] |date=January 18, 2015 |access-date=October 24, 2018}}</ref> They stated in 2017 that they were not in any rush to be married.<ref name=Wedding>{{cite news |url=https://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/dylan-mcdermott-reveals-why-he-hasnt-married-maggie-q-yet |title=Dylan McDermott reveals why he hasn't married Maggie Q yet |author=Staff writers |work=[[Fox News]] |date=September 27, 2017 |access-date=October 24, 2018}}</ref> They ended their relationship in February 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://people.com/tv/dylan-mcdermott-maggie-q-split/|title=Dylan McDermott and Maggie Q Split Following 4-Year Engagement|last1=Jordan|first1=Julie|last2=Stone|first2=Natalie|work=[[People (magazine)|People]]|date=February 28, 2019|access-date=March 4, 2019}}</ref>

Q has five [[tattoo]]s: a cross on her right forearm; [[Standard Tibetan|Tibetan]] script and a little triangle on her left forearm; a [[Zulu language|Zulu]] proverb on her side—"umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu", which means "a person's character is made by the collective"; and one of a [[Phoenix (mythology)|phoenix]] on her left hip, which she has had to conceal for most of her roles except ''Nikita''.<ref name="Tat">{{cite web |url=http://blog.zap2it.com/frominsidethebox/2010/07/nikita-maggie-q-reveals-her-tattoos-origin-story.html |title='Nikita': Maggie Q reveals her tattoo's origin story |publisher=[[Zap2it]] |access-date=October 23, 2010 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101031064647/http://blog.zap2it.com/frominsidethebox/2010/07/nikita-maggie-q-reveals-her-tattoos-origin-story.html |archive-date=October 31, 2010}}</ref> She suffered temporary [[hearing loss]] in her right ear after her eardrum was damaged during an explosive stunt in 2010.<ref name="MaximUKDeaf">{{cite web|url=http://www.maxim.co.uk/girls/celebrity/128/maggie_q.html|title=Maggie Q|work=Maxim UK|access-date=October 31, 2010|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111005141914/http://www.maxim.co.uk/girls/celebrity/128/maggie_q.html|archive-date=October 5, 2011|url-status=dead}}</ref>

She owned a house in [[Pound Ridge, New York]],<ref>{{cite web|last=Truong |first=Peggy |url=http://www.celebuzz.com/2013-07-29/nikita-star-maggie-q-buys-historic-1-2m-new-york-estate/ |title='Nikita' Star Maggie Q Buys Historic $1.2M New York Estate |publisher=Celebuzz |date=July 29, 2013 |access-date=March 12, 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last=Sherman |first=Catherine |url=http://www.zillow.com/blog/maggie-q-sells-studio-city-stunner-for-rustic-mill-house-128754/ |title=Maggie Q Sells Studio City Stunner for Rustic Mill House |publisher=Zillow.com |date=July 30, 2013 |access-date=March 12, 2015}}</ref> which she sold to [[Zoe Kravitz]] in 2021.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Halberg |first1=Morgan |title=Zoe Kravitz Paid $1.45 Million for a Charming Pound Ridge Home |url=https://observer.com/2021/10/zoe-kravitz-buys-westchester-pound-ridge-home-new-york/ |website=Observer |access-date=28 January 2024 |date=2021-10-21}}</ref> She announced she was married on the July 7, 2025 episode of ''[[Live with Kelly and Mark]]''.<ref>{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAfJiWz3wpk |title=Maggie Q's Friends Knew Her Husband Was the One Before She Did |date=2025-07-07 |last=LiveKellyandMark |access-date=2025-07-08 |via=YouTube}}</ref> She married Vietnam-born, US-raised entrepreneur Curtis Macnguyen, a retired hedge fund manager and entrepreneur, best known for founding Ivory Investment Management in 1998.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Gacute |first=Angilene |date=2025-07-12 |title=Maggie Q Is Married! 5 Things to Know About the 'Ballard' Actress' Husband Curtis Macnguyen |url=https://okmagazine.com/p/maggie-q-husband-curtis-macnguyen/ |access-date=2025-07-21 |website=OK Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Activism==
Q is outspoken on the subject of [[animal rights]] and has taken part in [[People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals|PETA]] Asia's campaigns promoting vegetarianism.<ref>{{cite press release|url=http://www.petaasia.com/news/nearly-nude-maggie-q-says-spice-up-your-life-go-vegetarian/ |title=Features | Nearly Nude Maggie Q Says, 'Spice Up Your Life - Go Vegetarian' |publisher=PETA Asia-Pacific |access-date=March 12, 2015}}</ref> A [[vegetarian]] for many years, she has said that giving up meat was one of the most rewarding decisions she has ever made. "I feel better, I have more energy, on and off the set, and I have the satisfaction of knowing that I'm doing something to help stop animal suffering." In 2008, she was named PETA Asia-Pacific's Person of the Year,<ref name="PETAAsiaPacPofY08">{{cite press release|url=http://www.petaasiapacific.com/newsreleasesitem.asp?id=10173|title=Maggie Q Named PETA's Person of the Year|publisher=PETA Asia-Pacific|access-date=October 23, 2010|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110722212504/http://www.petaasiapacific.com/newsreleasesitem.asp?id=10173|archive-date=July 22, 2011}}</ref> and PETA listed her as one of the Best-Dressed Celebrities of 2008. She has since taken the step to cut all animal products from her diet by becoming a [[vegan]].<ref name="PETAAsiaPacBestDressedCelebs08">{{cite web|url=http://www.petaasiapacific.com/feature-best-dressed-celebs-08.asp|title=PETA Announces the Best-Dressed Celebrities|publisher=PETA Asia-Pacific|access-date=October 23, 2010|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100819074736/http://www.petaasiapacific.com/feature-best-dressed-celebs-08.asp|archive-date=August 19, 2010}}</ref> PETA named her one of their three Sexiest Vegans of 2017.<ref>{{cite web |first=Daisy |last=Murray |title=PETA's 'Sexiest Vegan' List Is In, And Not Just One, But Three Women Won |url=http://www.elleuk.com/life-and-culture/culture/news/a36943/petas-sexiest-vegan-list-women/ |work=ELLE |date=July 10, 2017}}</ref> She is currently an ambassador for [[Animals Asia Foundation]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/AnimalsAsia/videos/3046292172261595/|title=Entrepreneur & Hollywood star Maggie Q pledges support and names a bear!|via=Facebook}}</ref>

== Business ventures ==
In 2019, Q launched Qeep Up, a sustainable activewear brand manufacturing women's apparel including [[leggings]], sports bras, and [[Swimsuit|swimwear]] from recycled ocean waste and post-consumer materials.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Palmieri |first=Jean E. |date=2019-09-04 |title=Exclusive: Actress Maggie Q Launching Activewear Line |url=https://wwd.com/fashion-news/activewear/exclusive-actress-maggie-q-launching-activewear-line-1203252183/ |access-date=2026-09-22 |website=WWD |language=en-US}}</ref> The clothing line is produced in ethical factories in Los Angeles, California, with yarn created from plastics collected on the [[Eastern Seaboard]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Why We're Different |url=https://qeepupnation.com/pages/why-were-different |access-date=2026-09-22 |website=Qeep Up |language=en}}</ref>

in 2017, she founded ActivatedYou with Frank Lipman, an integrative medicine physician and gut-health expert.<ref>{{Cite web |last=MEDIA |first=CNS |title=Maggie Q launches “self-care” prebiotic to boost metabolism and manage weight |url=https://www.nutritioninsight.com/news/maggie-q-launches-self-care-prebiotic-to-boost-metabolism-and-manage-weight.html |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=Nutrition Insight |language=en}}</ref> The brand produces a range of dietary supplements and nutritional products designed to support digestive health, energy, and overall wellness.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Born |first=Savannah |date=2025-04-02 |title=Detox, Debloat and Reduce Stress Every Morning With This All-in-One Superfood Powder |url=https://www.usmagazine.com/shop-with-us/news/activatedyou-morning-complete-daily-wellness-drink/ |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=Us |language=en-US}}</ref> Q has stated that her involvement in the company was inspired by her personal health research and began over a decade before its public launch.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IN CONVERSATION WITH MAGGIE Q |url=https://www.numeronetherlands.com/in-conversation-with/in-conversation-with-maggie-q |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=Numéro Netherlands |language=en-US}}</ref> 

Both ventures reflect Q's long-standing commitment to animal rights, environmental sustainability, and wellness advocacy. ActivatedYou sponsors the Animal Rescue Mission,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Giving Back |url=http://activatedyou.com/giving-back |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=ActivatedYou |language=en}}</ref> a charity that works to rescue, rehabilitate, re-home homeless and abused animals, primarily in the [[Los Angeles]] area.
